metadata.question: Did the mean tropospheric nitrogen dioxide levels over Taiwan increase between February 10-25, 2020 and April 20-May 12, 2020?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about tropospheric nitrogen dioxide (NO2) levels over Taiwan during two specific time periods in 2020. This requires: 1. Data Source: Sentinel-5P TROPOMI data which provides tropospheric NO2 measurements 2. Bands: 'tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density' 3. Time periods: - Feb 10-25, 2020 - Apr 20-May 12, 2020 4. Location: Taiwan (need to define geometry) 5. Processing: Calculate mean NO2 for each period and compare 6. Quality: TROPOMI data has quality flags, so I should mask poor quality data Strategy: - Use COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2 collection - Filter by date ranges and Taiwan geometry - Apply quality masking using 'qa_value' band - Calculate mean NO2 for each period - Compare if mean increased from period1 to period2 Potential issues: - Empty collections (C1) - No valid pixels after quality masking (C2) - Invalid calculations (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define Taiwan geometry var taiwan = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([119.5, 21.5, 122.5, 25.5]); // Define time periods var period1_start = '2020-02-10'; var period1_end = '2020-02-25'; var period2_start = '2020-04-20'; var period2_end = '2020-05-12'; // Function to process NO2 data function processNO2Collection(startDate, endDate) { var collection = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S5P/OFFL/L3_NO2') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(taiwan) .select(['tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density', 'qa_value']); // Apply quality mask (qa_value > 0.5 for good quality) var maskedCollection = collection.map(function(image) { var quality = image.select('qa_value'); var no2 = image.select('tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density'); return no2.updateMask(quality.gt(0.5)); }); return maskedCollection; } // Get collections for both periods var period1_col = processNO2Collection(period1_start, period1_end); var period2_col = processNO2Collection(period2_start, period2_end); // Check collection sizes var period1_size = period1_col.size().getInfo(); var period2_size = period2_col.size().getInfo(); print('Period 1 (Feb 10-25) Images: ' + period1_size); print('Period 2 (Apr 20-May 12) Images: ' + period2_size); // Handle empty collections if (period1_size === 0 || period2_size === 0) { print('C1'); return; } // Create mean composites and calculate statistics var period1_mean = period1_col.mean(); var period2_mean = period2_col.mean(); // Calculate mean NO2 values over Taiwan var period1_stats = period1_mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: taiwan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); var period2_stats = period2_mean.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: taiwan, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); var p1_result = period1_stats.getInfo(); var p2_result = period2_stats.getInfo(); var p1_mean = p1_result.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density; var p1_count = p1_result.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count; var p2_mean = p2_result.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density; var p2_count = p2_result.tropospheric_NO2_column_number_density_count; print('Period 1 Mean NO2: ' + (p1_mean ? p1_mean.toFixed(6) : 'No data')); print('Period 1 Valid Pixels: ' + p1_count); print('Period 2 Mean NO2: ' + (p2_mean ? p2_mean.toFixed(6) : 'No data')); print('Period 2 Valid Pixels: ' + p2_count); // Check for no valid pixels if (p1_count === 0 || p2_count === 0) { print('C2'); return; } // Check for invalid calculations if (p1_mean === null || p2_mean === null || isNaN(p1_mean) || isNaN(p2_mean) || p1_mean < 0 || p2_mean < 0) { print('C3'); return; } // Compare means and determine answer if (p2_mean > p1_mean) { print('A'); } else { print('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
